doc: Turtle breakout system (Curtis Faith, Way of the Turtle, McGraw-Hill 2007; Richard Dennis's rules). Entry on a price breakout of the highest high or lowest low of the previous N days: System 1 uses 20 days (exit at the 10-day opposite extreme) and System 2 uses 55 days (exit at 20). The Donchian channels of 20 (thin) and 55 (thick) days are drawn one bar late, so each line is the extreme of the previous N bars, the level today's price must break. The pane is N, the Turtles' volatility unit: a 20-day average true range with Wilder's smoothing, N = (19 x previous N + true range) / 20; position size is 1% of equity divided by N in dollars, and the stop is 2N from entry. Pyramiding every 1/2 N is not drawn.
